mechanics.claim: The empowered on-hit attack consumes both stacks and becomes a non-projectile guaranteed-hit attack, dealing bonus magic damage and granting bonus movement speed.
mechanics.quote: At 2 stacks, her next basic attack {{tip|on-attack}} consumes them all to become {{tip|projectile|non-projectile}}, deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} and grant her {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} for 1 second.

mechanics.claim: Basic attacks generate a refreshing stack of Shapesplitter on-hit.
mechanics.quote: '''Neeko's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} {{tip|on-hit}} generate a {{tip|stack}} of ''Shapesplitter'',  which refreshes on subsequent attacks and stacks up to 2 times.

mechanics.claim: The empowered attack will not trigger against wards and jungle plants.
mechanics.quote: The empowered attack will not trigger against {{tip|wards}} and [[jungle plants]].

mechanics.claim: The active clone's cooldown starts only after the clone expires.
Shapesplitter can be recast at any time while the clone is active to redirect it, and this recast does not count as an ability activation for on-cast effects.
mechanics.quote: Recasting ''Shapesplitter'' does not count as an ability activation for the purposes of on-cast effects such as {{tip|Spellblade}} and triggering {{ais|Force Pulse|Kassadin}} passive.
